The report's own seed_main_effect finds no shared seed effect (F 0.0148, p 0.9853), so pairing buys nothing here. The report's estimator band already spans 0.031106 kW (unpaired, sigma at pooled df) to 0.049762 kW (paired), and it governs by the most favourable of the three estimators.
resolution_report_caveat.caveat_2_censoring_is_not_a_lower_bound: Censored optimization does NOT by itself prove that the observed seed variance is a lower bound. 8 of the 15 retained cells stopped on UPDATE_BUDGET (censored_by_budget true); the within-arm pooled slope is +1.1481697636690154e-05 kW per update with r 0.6346, i.e. in these cells MORE updates went with a WORSE error, so lifting a short arm to the common ceiling would move its mean UP. The report's own caveat states the update counts are themselves outcomes of early stopping, that the relation is observational within the retained cells, and that ONLY a budget-matched re-run measures the causal effect of budget. Censoring could therefore inflate or deflate the observed dispersion; neither direction is established.
resolution_report_caveat.caveat_3_estimand: The declared estimand is equal_updates, declared before the comparison. metrics_units_and_source_transformations.why_this_is_here: so that a reader of a row never has to open a result table to learn what a number means. Where a row quotes a number, the unit is beside it; the transformation that produced it is here.

kW.what: kilowatts of household active power, the panel's own physical unit
kW.used_by: H-CORE (resolution, module effects, matched contrast) and R0/R1/R2-ECL
kW.transformation: predictions and targets are produced in the scaled space of a stored scaler fitted on TRAIN windows only, then inverted to kW before any error is formed. MAE in kW is the mean absolute error over the run's own evaluation origins in kW.
kW.two_panels_never_mixed: the doctoral household panel (minute-level active power, window 60, horizon 60 steps, 10,020 evaluation rows, matched persistence 0.6173720558882235 kW) and the ECL panel (1,802 label-disjoint windows, matched persistence 0.868283 kW) are DIFFERENT DATASETS. Their kW numbers are never pooled, averaged or compared.

persistence_scaled_error.what: dimensionless: model MAE in kW divided by a matched persistence MAE in kW on the identical evaluation origins
persistence_scaled_error.never_mixed_with_kW: a kW quantity and a scaled quantity are never subtracted from or divided by one another. The resolution report states this rule explicitly and the earlier violation of it is retracted there.

MSE_and_MAE_on_the_SOTA_panels.what: A/B report four-horizon mean MSE and MAE in the published recipe's own normalized units, NOT in a physical unit, because the published ECL L512 reference is defined in that space
